svg.title: THE RESIDENT
svg.desc: The exact stepped ghost from the entrance banner uses a laptop in a dark haunted garage with a black cat, cracked stone, cobwebs, spider and pumpkins. The outer back of the laptop lid faces the viewer. The ghost bobs and blinks behind the laptop, a spider descends and candle embers rise. The bio remains still; candle and pumpkin light flicker. building something pretty useless in my garage. sometimes it even works.
